entry.title: October 19, 2026 filings: SEC Regulation Crypto Assets, Tokenized NMS Stock, and Treasury GENIUS Section 3
entry.summary: Between October 13 and October 19, 2026, the comment-letter program filed four submissions across three federal dockets (Treasury GENIUS section 3, SEC Regulation Crypto Assets, and SEC tokenized NMS stock conditional exemptions), bringing the program to 25 letters across 19 dockets and 136 recommendations.

entry.title: GENIUS Act rules in October 2026: fourteen rulemakings, one in effect
entry.summary: The statutory deadline passed in July without a final rule. As of October 12, fourteen implementing rulemakings are tracked: one in effect, three open for comment and ten awaiting final action. The Act's effective date is now January 18, 2027 by its own formula.
